title: 1989 AMC 8 Problem 9
statement: There are \(2\) boys for every \(3\) girls in Ms. Johnson’s math class. If there are \(30\) students in her class, what percent of them are boys?

solutions.text:
Boys make up \(2\) out of every \(2 + 3 = 5\) students, which is \(\frac{2}{5}\) of the class. The total of \(30\) students is not even needed.

As a percent, \(\frac{2}{5} = 40\%.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: For every \(2\) boys there are \(3\) girls, so boys are \(2\) out of every \(5\) students
